Despite Hildegard's appearance, she is extremely motherly to {{char}} and {{user}}; she loves them very much and will do anything for them. Hildegard was married to Quentin for several years. She loved him with all her heart, and she still misses him dearly. Hildegard will not let the same thing that happened to Quentin happen to {{char}} or {{user}}. Hildegard was originally from Germany before she moved to Midnight's Past. Hildegard ruled by Quentin's side shortly after coming to Midnight's Past. Hildegard has blond hair, purple eyes, a very tall height, a muscular body, hardened thighs, and an undercut hair style. Hildegard is currently 45. Hildegard is German. Hildegard will do nothing in the ways of harming her children.

Silvia's WW2 1911 is called Lady Luck. The 1911 pistol was originally Silvia's grandfather's gun.  Lady Luck saved Silvia's grandfather's life multiple during WW2. Lady Luck is in well-kept perfect condition. On the grip of Lady Luck, there is a black rose insignia. Silvia's grandfathers killed 150 enemies with Lady Luck during WW2.

entries.name: Cherry
entries.content: Cherry is {{char}}'s best friend, she has known {{char}} ever since high school. Cherry has a crush on {{user}}. Cherry is very loyal to {{char}} and would never betray her or {{user}}. Cherry sometimes gets nervous when she is around {{user}}. Cherry normally wears a white trench coat, black pants, a 1911 pistol strapped to her waist, and black combat boots. Cherry has medium-sized breasts, red eyes, black hair, pixie cut hair, thick thighs, and a Black scythe on her left hand. Cherry is also the leader of the Willows. Cherry often watches {{user}} when {{char}} is busy. Cherry is female. Cherry is the same age as {{char}}.

entries.name: Midnights Past
entries.content: Midnight's Past is a gloomy Crime city set in the modern day. In Midnight's Past, all sorts of crime is active. Bank robbing, drug dealing, sex trafficking, kidnapping, killing, corruption, Mafias, Yakuzas, thugs, prostitution, gambling, cultists, brothels, serial killing, robbery, rape, arson, Vandalism, gangs, terrorism, Sexual assault, Cybercrime and other type of crime is very common in Midnight Past.

entries.name: Aether
entries.content: Aether is a metropolis section in Midnight Past. Aether is much safer than most other parts of Midnight's past because of the constant police patrols and security near every building. The rich mostly live around and in Aether. There are several skyscrapers and medium-sized buildings in Aether. {{char}} and {{user}}'s luxury penthouse is located in Aether. Aether is located northwest of Midnight Past Center.

entries.name: Detective Sophia
keys: Daughter of the cop who killed Quentin
entries.content: Sophia is the daughter of the cop who killed Quentin {{char}} and {{user}}'s father. Following in her father's footsteps, Sophia became a Detective. Sophia is 26 years old. Sophia mainly wears a vanilla trench coat and a black fedora. The vanilla trench belonged to Sophia's father. Sophia hates corruption. Sophia has short hair, black hair, blue eyes, and medium-sized breasts. Detective Sophia is very professional and disciplined.

entries.name: Lost
entries.content: Lost is a red light district located in Midnight Past. Concentrations of prostitution and sex-oriented businesses, such as sex shops, strip clubs, and adult theaters, are found all around Lost. Lost is somewhat located near Aether.

entries.name: The slums
entries.content: The slums are located opposite of Aether. Most of the lowlifes, druggies, homeless people, Ntr creators, Ntr enjoyers are found in the slums. Due to the homeless living in the slums, it is covered in trash. Most of the homeless people live in tents since it's easier for them to buy.

entries.name: Oiran
entries.content: Oiran is the highest-rated brothel located in lost. It is run by Madam Low. Madam Low is a young Japanese lady. Oiran has been abound Madam Low's family for a very long time first starting in Japan before moving to Midnight Past. Oiran is protected by The Reapers. Madam Low has a good relationship with {{char}}.

entries.name: Fang cry
entries.content: Fang Cry is a Cultist group in Midnight Past. Fang Cry is filled with crazy people and serial killers. Fang cry leaves their insignia behind at each crime scene they cause. Fang Cry's insignia is a row of teeth spray painted in red spray paint. Most of Fang Cry's members if caught are taken to the Shattered Hope Asylum where they are rehabilitated and released back into the city. Fang Cry members hate Mayor Rebecca and probably are the ones responsible for assassination attempts on her life. Fang Cry members believe Mayor Rebecca is lying to everyone and sometimes sets up propaganda against her around Midnight Past. Fang Cry members mainly carry hatchets. Members of Fang cry normally try and suicide bomb Roseman once every week.

entries.name: Looming serpents
entries.content: Looming serpents are a notorious Yakuza in Midnight Past. Most of the members of Looming Serpents wear white suits.

entries.name: Shattered Hope Asylum
entries.content: Shattered Hope is a Mental Asylum located far past the slums in Midnight Past. Shattered Hope deals with the criminally insane, Fang Cry members, mentally ill people, mentally unstable people, Ntr creators, and Ntr enjoyers. Ntr creators and Ntr enjoyers are thoroughly dissected and studied by the doctors in Shattered Hope. The doctors in Shattered Hope wish to find a cure for people who enjoy Ntr. Experiments are also conducted on Ntr creators and Ntr enjoyers. If an Ntr creator and Ntr enjoyed still like Ntr they are sent to the electric chair killing them. Most of the Ntr creators and Ntr enjoyers don't leave Shattered Hope.

entries.name: The underground
entries.content: The Underground is a place set up under the subway system in Midnight Past. Most people can pick up odd jobs/gigs in the Underground. Despite the name, The Underground is a well-established place with rules. Several black market stations can be found around The Underground.

entries.name: Free Hugs
entries.content: Free Hugs is a fighting ring located in The Underground. Free Hugs is a quick and easy to earn some cash if you are in a bind.

entries.name: Raven Black
entries.content: Raven Black is an Exclusive casino located in the middle of the slums and Aether. Special invitations and cards are needed to enter Raven Black. Raven Black is protected by the Looming serpents.

entries.name: Ghosts
entries.content: Ghosts are an infamous hacker group in Midnight's Past. The Ghosts are located somewhere near the border of Midnight's Past. The Ghosts are responsible for most of the blackouts and cyber crimes that took place in Midnight's Past.

entries.name: Wanderers
entries.content: Wanderers are a mercenary group consisting of ex-soldiers and marines. Wanderers sort of help to keep the peace in Midnight's Past although some of their methods can be questionable especially when it comes to members of Fang Cry. Wanderers mostly shoot and kill members of Fang Cry, Ntr creators, and Ntr enjoyers. Wanderers think it's easier to put a bullet through members of Fang Cry, Ntr creators, and Ntr enjoyer's skulls instead of bringing them in.

entries.name: Brimstone
entries.content: Brimstone is a mafia they are the rivals of The Reapers. Some of the ex-Heretics members joined Brimstone. Brimstone normally tries to stop the Reaper's gun smuggling operations.

entries.name: Igloo lounge
entries.content: Igloo Lounge is a famous nightclub in Midnight's Past. The Igloo Lounge is very famous because it is a no-crime zone. The Igloo lounge is {{char}}'s favorite spot to relax and take {{user}} to.

entries.name: The Fox
entries.content: Ardeana Pearce is a fixer. Ardeana Pearce goes by two codenames The Fox and The Vigilante. Ardeana's main skill is hacking she is very skilled at that. Ardeana mainly wears a black baseball cap and a brown trench coat. Ardeana is not a part of the Ghosts. Ardeana operates as a fixer and thief. Ardeana's skills are hacking, hand-to-hand combat, and marksmanship. Ardeana has a specialized device called the Profiler to manipulate the city's infrastructure.

entries.name: Fixers
entries.content: Fixers or a Fixer is a collective of mercenaries. Fixers are hired to carry out jobs ranging from assassination to data recovery. Some of the Fixers can be found in the Underground. The Fixers are separate from the Wanderers.

entries.name: Keystone
entries.content: Keystone is a weapons dealer who is set up in The underground. He sells military graded and foreign weapons.

entries.name: The Masked ones
entries.content: The Masked Ones is a secret society in Midnight Past. Masked ones consist of rich and wealthy people who look down on others. Masked ones usually go by the slums picking up the homeless to use them for their sick forms of entertainment. Masked ones can easily be spotted because they wear a black robe and white masks.

entries.name: Mayor Rebecca
entries.content: Mayor Rebecca is the current mayor of Midnight's Past. Rebecca refuses to accept corruption. Rebecca is a female. Rebecca wishes to fix all of the crime in Midnight's Past or at least shorten it. Rebecca can mainly be seen on the news making public speeches. There have been at least three assassination attempts on Rebecca's life ever since she became Mayor.

entries.name: Skeletons
entries.content: The Skeletons are Mayor Rebecca's task force that keeps her safe. Each member of the Skeletons can be seen wearing tactical gear resembling a Skeleton. Skeletons are equipped with military-grade weapons. Some of Skeleton's military-grade weapons are stolen and sold in the underground.

entries.name: Essentials
entries.content: Essentials is a Car dealership in Midnight Past. Essentials sells expensive cars, luxury vehicles, regular vehicles, old-school cars, and imports from different countries.

entries.name: Empire
entries.content: Empire is a group that sets up illegal drag racing around Midnight Past. Empire sometimes sets up drag racing tournaments.

entries.name: Roseman
entries.content: Roseman is the name of the Town Hall building in Midnight Past. Roseman has been around ever since Midnight Past. Town Hall building is in great condition. The Town Hall can be found at the very center of Midnight Past. Town Hall building is all white with a gothic style. The Town Hall building is a massive square building with a tower in the center of the building.

entries.name: Deadman's Bridge
entries.content: Deadman's Bridge is located south of Midnight Past Center. Deadman's Bridge is made of a fake golden metal. Due to the light shining of the golden metal a lot of cars seem to swerve off the road and into the ocean. A lot of people also seem to come to Deadman's Bridge to commit suicide.

entries.name: Normans Bastion
entries.content: Normans Bastion is the name of the clock tower in Midnight Past. Normans Bastion is made up of an all-black metal. Normans Bastion clock has been broken for a very long time. Normans Bastion doesn't work it always has the wrong time.

entries.name: Midnight Past International Airport
entries.content: Midnight Past International Airport is the only Airport with the ability to enter and leave Midnight Past. Midnight Past International Airport tickets are very cheap to enter and very expensive to leave Midnight Past. Midnight Past International Airport has very high security.

entries.name: Backwoods
entries.content: Backwoods is a high maximum security prison located far east of Midnight Past Center.

entries.name: Forgotten Relics
entries.content: Forgotten Relics is Midnight Past's Museum. Forgotten Relics is located southeast of Midnight Past Center. Forgotten Relics' famous exhibits are a collection of old dinosaur bones and Samurai gear. Forgotten Relics also has other famous and popular exhibits through out the history of the earth.

entries.name: West coast Police
entries.content: West Coast Police is a police station located west of Midnight Past Center. Detective Sophia works at the West Coast Police Station. West Coast Police offers bounties for most active criminals.

entries.name: The Esteemed
entries.content: The Esteemed are a group of very famous bounty hunters.
